revision: the section pages read 14 Nov 2026 22:3x-22:5x +04 (SHA-256 of each page in section_info)
holder_unknown: not named in the section's table
holder_sources: the reference in the last column of the section's table, from its list of references
pending_queue: Packomania's list of pending requests (pending.html, dated 9 Nov 2026, read 14 Nov) holds unreviewed candidates for several of these sections (among them the pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, decagon, tetradecagon, pentadecagon, hexadecagon, heptadecagon and ccis); their values are not published, so a cell's best known value is the table's, and a candidate in the queue may already beat it
title: Circles of radii i^(1/2), i^(-1/2), i^(-2/3), i^(-1/5) in the smallest circle or square

template.title: Circles i = 1..{n} with the radii of Packomania section {section} in the smallest container
template.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles, circle i of the radius given by section {section}, in the container of that section whose size V is as small as possible.
template.submission: Text file: V on the first line, then {n} lines with the centres of circles 1, 2, ..., {n} in that order (decimal numbers), in the frame of checkers/pack_alg_check.py for section {section}.

ccir.title: Circles of radii i^(1/2), i = 1..{n}, in a circle of radius V centred at 0 (Packomania ccir)
ccir.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles, circle i of radius i^(1/2), in a circle of radius V centred at 0 with V as small as possible.

ccis.title: Circles of radii i^(-1/2), i = 1..{n}, in a circle of radius V centred at 0 (Packomania ccis)
ccis.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles, circle i of radius i^(-1/2), in a circle of radius V centred at 0 with V as small as possible.

ccic.title: Circles of radii i^(-2/3), i = 1..{n}, in a circle of radius V centred at 0 (Packomania ccic)
ccic.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles, circle i of radius i^(-2/3), in a circle of radius V centred at 0 with V as small as possible.

ccib.title: Circles of radii i^(-1/5), i = 1..{n}, in a circle of radius V centred at 0 (Packomania ccib)
ccib.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles, circle i of radius i^(-1/5), in a circle of radius V centred at 0 with V as small as possible.

csqr.title: Circles of radii i^(1/2), i = 1..{n}, in the square [0,V]^2 (Packomania csqr)
csqr.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles, circle i of radius i^(1/2), in the square [0,V]^2 with V as small as possible.

csqs.title: Circles of radii (N/i)^(1/2), i = 1..{n}, in the square [0,V]^2 (Packomania csqs)
csqs.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles, circle i of radius (N/i)^(1/2), in the square [0,V]^2 with V as small as possible.

score: the size V of the container (smaller is better)
best_text: The best known container in Packomania's table has size {best} ({holder}); a valid packing in a smaller one improves it.
open_rule: every listed N of the sections ccir, ccis, ccic and ccib (N = 5..100) and every N >= 4 of csqr and csqs whose value is not in bold (none is)
left_out: ccir: 0 proven, 0 small N; ccis: 0 proven, 0 small N; ccic: 0 proven, 0 small N; ccib: 0 proven, 0 small N; csqr: 0 proven, 3 small N; csqs: 0 proven, 3 small N; the section csqc, whose radius and ratio columns disagree for some N

ccir.container: a circle of radius V centred at 0

ccis.container: a circle of radius V centred at 0

ccic.container: a circle of radius V centred at 0

ccib.container: a circle of radius V centred at 0

frames: checked on Packomania's coordinate files ccir20, ccis20, ccic20, ccib20, csqr20 and csqs20 (Packomania's ratio is V; for csqs it is the side over the smallest radius, hence the radii (N/i)^(1/2)): each passes with the coordinates spread by 10^-9 and V 10^-8 above the listed value, and fails 10^-8 below
